review_candidates.description: POSITION SUMMARY: The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is responsible for comprehensive planning, development, and direction of all company operations in alignment with strategic goals and objectives established by the President and Chief Executive Officer (CEO). This role drives operational excellence, translates strategy into execution, and ensures scalable business processes across all functional areas. The COO establishes operational policies and procedures, evaluates performance results, and assumes full responsibility for company administration in the President and Chief Executive Officer’s absence. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: • Partners with CEO and executive team to develop and execute organizational goals and strategic plans while providing expertise and guidance on projects, operations, and systems. • Translates strategic objectives into actionable operational plans with clear milestones and accountability. Develops the organization's short- and long-term goals and strategies and ensures that business processes and operational controls are in place to support those goals and strategies. • Evaluates and optimizes processes across multiple functional areas, implementing efficiency improvements and performance enhancements. Establishes and monitors KPIs to track progress and reports on operating results to ensure consistent growth and progress towards achieving organizational goals. • Provides direct leadership for core operational business units/functional areas directly related to delivering products and services to market, including Product Development and commercialization, Research & Engineering, Operations & Manufacturing (including supply chain and distribution), Quality Assurance & Regulatory Compliance, and Customer Support & Service Delivery. • Implements industry best practices and operational methodologies to ensure high-quality operations and delivery. Fosters a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence. Drives standardization of workflows, systems, and procedures to enhance productivity and scalability. • Ensures company operations comply with local, state, and federal laws, regulations, and industry standards (FDA, GMP, etc.). Develops and implements risk management strategies to identify, assess, and mitigate operational, regulatory, and business risks. • Collaborates with Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to develop and manage operational budgets and resource allocation. Monitors expenditures and implements cost-control measures to optimize efficiency. Develops business cases and ROI analyses for major investments. • Builds and leads high-performing operational teams across multiple functional areas. Establishes clear performance expectations and provides coaching and mentorship. Promotes a collaborative culture that values accountability, innovation, and results. • Represents the company to external stakeholders, including partners, investors, and regulatory bodies. Conducts strategic reviews to assess progress, identify risks, and adjust plans as conditions evolve. EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS: • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, or PhD) in Business Administration, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field. • Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in operational management. o A minimum of five years in a senior executive leadership role (VP or C-suite) with multi-unit responsibility. • Experience in a biotechnology or life sciences highly preferred. • Demonstrated success managing operations in FDA-regulated or GMP environments. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES: • Proven track record of developing and implementing successful operational strategies that drive business growth and profitability. • Exceptional leadership skills with proven ability to inspire, develop, and retain top talent. Strong executive presence with confidence, integrity, and C-suite presence. Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of staff management practices and processes and the ability to establish accountabilities and expectations and manage performance to achieve results. • Expert knowledge of business operations, including strategic planning, effective budget development and management processes, as well as the ability to translate strategic thinking into action plans and related outcomes. • Strong business and financial acumen with P&L management experience. Proven negotiation and mediation skills, as well as a demonstrated attention to detail and a focus on achieving quality outcomes. Commercial orientation with understanding of customer needs and market dynamics. • The ability to build/foster relationships by reinforcing trust and respect and demonstrating high standards of tact, diplomacy and discretion. Outstanding communication skills with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively, both verbally and in writing. Ability to influence and build consensus across organizational levels. • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-energy, demanding and deadline driven environment. Demonstrates resilience, flexibility, and composure under pressure. Change management expertise and the ability to act accordingly. • A high level of confidence, integrity, interpersonal skills, and a professional executive presence for effectively interacting with and influencing others, internal and external to the company. • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the demonstrated ability to gather, evaluate and synthesize complex data and information and develop a recommendation and plan of action. • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and other operational software and tools. Familiarity with ERP systems, project management platforms, and business intelligence tools. • Ability to travel outside standard working hours with some overnight stays, including occasional international travel. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: This position requires the ability to communicate and exchange information, utilize equipment necessary to perform the job, and move about the office and manufacturing/laboratory environments.
